name: webtigers-skills
description: First-party Agent Skills for building on Tiger (TigerZF) — the WebTigers platform. Portable SKILL.md; works in Claude Code, the Claude API, and TigerAgent's in-app Skills browser.

plugins.name: tiger-module
plugins.description: Scaffold and build a complete Tiger feature module — controller, /api service, form, ACL, views, config, migrations, i18n — the update-safe "extend, don't edit" way.

plugins.name: tiger-webservice
plugins.description: Write a Tiger /api web service the right way — the single-endpoint TIGER message pattern, validate-then-transaction, deny-by-default ACL, and the standard response envelope.

plugins.name: tiger-admin-screen
plugins.description: Build a Tiger admin or account screen from the standard template so it matches the rest of the back office — the five pieces, saving through /api with TigerButton/TigerDOM.

plugins.name: tiger-design
plugins.description: Design and build the visual layer of a Tiger app the framework-native way — PUMA/Bootstrap 5 zero-build, skins as CSS-variable overlays, reskinnable .phtml views, CMS blocks/partials, GrapesJS components, theme modules.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max-php
plugins.description: A dependency-free PHP port of the ui-ux-pro-max design-intelligence database (50+ UI styles, ~190 palettes, font pairings, UX/accessibility guidelines, per-stack rules) searchable from one PHP script. Use before choosing any design tokens. Fork of nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill (MIT); that license governs this skill folder.
